items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, because Horowitz was so great, he didn’t have to even play the music as written no more. That’s how great he was. He was like a great soloist. But you knew that he could play the music like it was written, if he wanted to. But he was a virtuoso.

ctx.x: Horowitz or something like that. Actually they say Horowitz used to come and see him play.

Yeah, because Horowitz was so great, he didn’t have to even play the music as written no more. That’s how great he was. He was like a great soloist. But you knew that he could play the music like it was written, if he wanted to. But he was a virtuoso.
He said in one of these interviews that Art Tatum was one of the greatest piano players he ever heard. Horowitz said this.
